_comment: lane -> agent name in delegate's agents.json. Kimi keeps its own internal lane ids (flash/glm/k3); this maps them to contract roles. 2026-10-26 (owner-directed): the seat ids ARE role names now — cheap->marathon-worker, substantial->substantial-worker, marathon->expert-worker. NOTE the collision this creates: the ladder ROLE `marathon` maps to the k3 lane, whose seat is `expert-worker`, while the seat id `marathon-worker` belongs to the FLASH lane. Ladder roles are a separate vocabulary and are due their own rename — never read a seat id as a role.
